basic_details.short_information: SPSC Veterinary Officer Interview 2026: The Sikkim Public Service Commission (SPSC) has released Notice No. 115/SPSC/EXAM/2026 dated 21/07/2026, shortlisting candidates for the Viva Voce/Interview round for 47 posts of Veterinary Officer. The interview will be held on 28 and 29 July 2026 at the SPSC office in Gangtok. Below is the complete roll number-wise schedule, e-admit card download details, and everything else you need to know.

content_sections.heading: SPSC Veterinary Officer Interview Schedule 2026 - Download Link
content_sections.text: SPSC Veterinary Officer Interview Schedule 2026 The Sikkim Public Service Commission (SPSC) has released the interview schedule for the Veterinary Officer recruitment under Notice No. 115/SPSC/EXAM/2026. The Viva Voce/Interview for 47 posts will be conducted on 28 and 29 July at the SPSC Office, Gangtok. Shortlisted candidates can download their e- admit card from 22 July 2026 and their allotted interview date with the required documents. Download SPSC Veterinary Officer Interview Schedule 2026

content_sections.heading: How to Download the e-Admit Card
content_sections.text: Visit the official SPSC website: https://spsc.sikkim.gov.in/ Look for the "e-Admit Card" or "Notices" section (available from 22/07/2026 onwards). Download and print the e-Admit Card for the Veterinary Officer Viva Voce. Carry the printed admit card along with a valid original photo ID to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q1. When is the SPSC Veterinary Officer interview 2026?
faq.answer: The interview/viva voce is scheduled on 28 and 29 July 2026, with candidates split by roll number across the two days.

faq.question: Q2. When can I download my SPSC Veterinary Officer e-Admit Card?
faq.answer: e-Admit Cards are available for download on the official SPSC website from 22/07/2026 onwards.

faq.question: Q3. What documents should I carry to the SPSC Veterinary Officer interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry the downloaded e-Admit Card and one valid original photo identity card.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the SPSC Veterinary Officer interview being held?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at the Office of the Sikkim Public Service Commission, Old Tourism Complex, MG Marg, Gangtok - 737101.

faq.question: Q5. Can a shortlisted candidate still be rejected after the interview?
faq.answer: Yes. Admission to the process is purely provisional. If a candidate is found ineligible at any stage - including during the interview - their candidature will be summarily rejected by the Commission.
